race.comment: KOIBITO (2) resumes here but the form she showed in her first preparation was good enough for a race of this calibre. Tuned up for this with two recent trials and should get a gun run in transit from gate two. Sure to be right there at the business end. PARTY REBEL (4) was well-supported at Scone on debut but just ran into one better on that occasion. Where there's smoke there's fire and can feature with natural improvement. ESNAAD (6) has put back-to-back placings together to open the career and has to be included in calculations. MUMBAI MAHARANI (3) has been readied with a couple of trials so can run a race while fresh.
